name: Pork Chop with Warm Fennel, Radish & Asparagus Salad over Lemon Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
1 fennel bulb
½ bunch radish
1 small bunch asparagus
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the yogurt sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp parsley flakes
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulb. Halve fennel bulb lengthwise, then slice into thin strips. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Trim and halve radishes lengthwise. Add to the baking sheet with the fennel, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until starting to soften, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in another small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Using your hands, rub with the garlic oil on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.

When the veggies have started to soften, remove baking sheet from oven. Add asparagus, toss to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes more. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Place peas in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl with the basil.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Transfer to the bowl with the basil and peas, along with almonds, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide yogurt sauce between plates or bowls, then top with veggies and pork chops. Enjoy!
